notes: The door's own boxes (ADR-0146), declared before the native sheet ports them (phase 5 of #1194). `strip` measures the horizontally scrolling row of apps and the control that opens the picker; `picker` measures the same add/remove sheet the strip's end control and the empty state open. The pills themselves are left out of `strip`: their order is the member's, so the contract measures the row, not one app's label - the app test that draws it is named by the gate entry when the sheet is ported, and until then this file is a contract with no recording, which `check:visual` reports as declared and not yet captured rather than pretending the page and an app agree. The sheet carries no visible title (ADR-0153), so there is no title box to measure. The empty state is the third state of the same surface and is recorded when the strip is.

motion.notes: Strip pills fade their border and background over 200ms and settle 5% smaller on press; the service sheet opens over the page and its rows fade their colour on hover. The same means the same colour transitions and the same open sheet position; loading the sheet is a pulse skeleton.
